title: Bijectivity of the canonical external section map on an affine rectangle
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $U\subset X$ and $V\subset Y$ be affine opens, and let $F$ and $G$ be quasi-coherent module sheaves [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $W=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}U\cap\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}V$ in $X\times_kY$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. The explicit map $\Gamma(F,U)\otimes_k\Gamma(G,V)\to\Gamma(\mathrm{pr}_1^*F\otimes\mathrm{pr}_2^*G,W)$, $s\otimes t\mapsto(\mathrm{pr}_1^*s)|_W\otimes(\mathrm{pr}_2^*t)|_W$, is bijective. Pullback here is tensorPullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and section modules have the scalar actions of [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. The map is constructed from the actual adjunction units and tensor product of sections; it is not chosen from an existence statement. No short exact sequence or exactness hypothesis is involved.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine case and equation-kunneth-on-cech; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: Construct the canonical bilinear map by restricting both projection pullback units to W. Its k-linearity uses the equality pr1 composed with f equals pr2 composed with g. Naturality in F follows from unit naturality, compatibility of module maps with restriction, and whiskerRight_app_tmulSection; test it on pure tensors and extend by TensorProduct.ext'. This construction and naturality are proved in the delivered module.

The rectangle W is affine by the upstream affine-rectangle lemma. Identify each tensor projection pullback with ordinary module pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward. Transport quasi-coherence across these isomorphisms.

Apply exists_affine_rectangle_projection_sections_tensor to obtain an additive equivalence e from factor section tensors to the ordinary projection-section tensor over Gamma(Z,W). Apply quasiCoherent_tensor_product_affine_sections to the two projection pullbacks on W. Tensor induction shows its composite with e equals picardExternalRectangleSectionsMap: the zero and addition cases follow from additivity, and the pure-tensor case follows from the formula for e and tensorSectionsMap_tmul, followed by unfolding the canonical bilinear map. Compose the two bijections.

proof_origin.place: Affine rectangle section comparison, proved by the ordinary projection-section tensor equivalence followed by affine tensor sections
